description: LatchBio | Member of Technical Staff (infra, ML infra, systems, platform, full stack) | ONSITE San Francisco | Full Time Our mission is to advance humanity's ability to engineer biology. I run our engineering team and will read and respond to all emails sent to aidan@latch.bio. You can also apply here via a more structured form: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/LatchBio .
